description: A React component for a modal dialog that allows users to flag (quarantine) a post message, including selecting a reason and adding comments.

methods.name: FlagPostModal
methods.description: React functional component rendering a modal for flagging a post, managing state and handling user interactions.

methods.name: handleOptionChange
methods.description: Handles change in reason selection, updates state and validation errors.

methods.name: handleCommentChange
methods.description: Handles change in comment textbox, updates state and validation errors.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates form inputs, sets error messages, returns boolean indicating presence of errors.

methods.name: handleConfirm
methods.description: Handles the confirmation action, performs validation, calls API to flag post, manages loading state.
